scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in npm/*) ;; *) echo "Use npm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@workspace/gold-swing-ai && npm run dev --workspace=@workspace/api-server
